mainEntity.name: What types of home gym additions are most popular for residential properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Popular home gym additions often include converting unused spaces like basements or garages, building dedicated extensions, or designing outdoor workout areas. The best option depends on your available space, budget, and desired equipment. For example, converting a garage might involve flooring upgrades, climate control, and electrical work to support heavy machinery, offering a practical tradeoff between cost and extensive construction.
